title: Quick Queso Pull Canadian Beef Kidney Grill
description: A romantic Canadian dish featuring nutty beef kidney, perfect for a cozy night in with friends and family.

ingredients.name: beef kidney
ingredients.notes: trim excess fat and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to medium-high heat.
Season the beef kidney with salt and pepper.
Add the beef kidney to the raclette grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned.
Remove the beef kidney from the grill and set aside.
In the same raclette grill, cook the sliced onions and minced garlic until softened.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese until melted.
Add the cooked beef kidney back to the raclette grill and spoon the cheese sauce over the top.
Return the raclette grill to medium heat and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the beef kidney and cheese sauce hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
Serve with a side of warm tortillas or crusty bread to mop up the cheese sauce.
